notes.title: Fixes and Updates
notes.notes:
Dear players and nostalgic friends,

Looking Back was updated with an array of bug and glitch fixes. The Steam overlay now works properly. Please continue to report bugs and glitches as you find them -- there should be very few left, but as new content is added, the possibilities of new bugs increase.

The game's commercial success has been modest, but the feedback I've received is tremendously positive! I'm thrilled that a handful of you have truly resonated with the game. I hope to reach even more people to increase that impact.

The Mac version has been very problematic and has thus been deactivated until further notice. Please accept my sincere apologies. I will do my very best to fix it in the next few months.

In terms of content, some secret/bonus stuff was added, one enemy was added, and a couple of endings have been implemented. The next patch should see a demon make its way into Kris's heart, and a new bittersweet memory as well, so stay tuned! I am also currently working on adding Steam achievements, which is my next priority.

Keep the feedback coming and don't hesitate to contact me! Happy Halloween!

With love,
Kris

notes.title: Game released and upcoming content!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! First of all, you have my sincere gratitude for purchasing and playing Looking Back! I'm truly honoured.

I'm super excited and nervous to present you my game! While it is far from perfect in its current state, I plan to keep improving it and regularly adding content in the next year. Definitely do stay updated!

Please do not hesitate to contact me directly if you encounter any issues or if you have any questions. I will get back to you as fast as I humanly can. I appreciate any positive and constructive feedback, and I aim to implement content according to what I hear from you.

I thank you once again for your time and for your interest in my game. It comes straight from my heart! Enjoy!


Elements that I'm working on for the first update (in approx. 2 weeks):

-Steam achievements.
-A couple more endings.
-More character development for Rinack and Willux.
-Balancing fights.
-Fixing a couple of glitches and some character portraits in dialogues.

Let me know of any suggestions and I will seriously consider adding them in the future!
